name: KeyBelt
notes: New: KeyBelt checks for PyMEL (other tools need it) and offers a one-click install when it is missing; status and button in Settings > General > Maya Preferences.

Time Dragger HUD: on a fresh Maya the key is routed even when Maya's hotkeys load late (retries for a few seconds at startup); recognises any spelling of Maya's Time Dragger command; when it can't take over the key, or falls back to Maya's own Time Dragger, the Script Editor says why.
